_source: Ankama's Dofus Retro client files, read 2026-11-13: dofusretro.cdn.ankama.com/lang/swf/spells_fr_1254.swf and classes_fr_1258.swf (both dated 2025-07-23). Class spells with a damage or life-steal line, one entry per grade 1 to 6. 0 = no limit. duration = poison over that many turns, chance = % of a random outcome, via = damage done by the trap or glyph the spell lays.
